name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold developer advancing the fully permitted Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study and is targeting first production in 2029, positioning itself as a near-term primary silver producer. Diablillos is one of South America's most prominent silver-gold development assets with an expanding mineral resource base.
